title: Kordylewski clouds as possible conscious plasma entities

tellings.quote: There are two of them as I recall at the L5 point. They are approximately nine times as large as the Earth itself.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a guest with a doctorate on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on an idea from the writer Robert Temple's book A New Science of Heaven about the Kordylewski clouds. These are two faint clouds said to sit at L5, a spot in space where the pulls of Earth and Moon balance out, and Mishlove recalls they are about nine times the size of Earth. Temple's suggestion is that they may be made of plasma, an electrically charged gas, and may be conscious beings in their own right.
